about_the_game:
Star Squadrons: Galactic Trading Card Game is a fast, tactical sci-fi TCG that connects two worlds at once: digitally on PC and as a physical card game. Both versions share the same unique ruleset — no mana, hidden card placement, tactical zone control, and monthly rotating battlefields.

Choose your opening hand, outplay opponents through timing, bluffing and positioning, and fight across shifting strategic battlefields.

🚀 A Hybrid TCG Across Digital and Physical Play

Star Squadrons aims to become the first fully connected digital + physical TCG ecosystem:

  • Play digitally on Steam
    and earn physical rewards through digital performance.

  • Play physically at local events
    and later sync your local competitive success into the global online ranking.

Digital play builds skill, visibility, and rankings — physical play builds community, events, and progression.
Both sides reinforce each other and form one unified trading card game experience.

🧠 Pure Strategy — Without Resource Frustration

  • No mana

  • No resource system

  • No dead draws and minimal downtime

  • Hidden card placement = constant mindgames

  • Players choose their opening hand

  • Victory comes from tactical zone superiority, not lifepoints

🌌 Monthly Rotating Battlefields

Each month introduces a new battlefield with changing tactical zones that influence combat and strategy — keeping the meta fresh, competitive, and evolving.

🏆 Global Online Ranking (Starting March 2026)

  • Fast online matches

  • Private matches

  • Monthly competitive ladders

  • Worldwide leaderboards

  • Seasonal resets

Your ranking performance directly ties into Play-2-Claim physical rewards.

📦 Physical Play-2-Claim Rewards

Starting March 2026, the Top 50 global digital players earn real, limited physical promo cards delivered worldwide.

All Star Squadrons promos are:

  • high-quality

  • foil-finished

  • strictly limited

  • collectible

  • non-pay-to-win

A physical reward system unique to Star Squadrons:

💫 Kickstarter 2026 — Physical Release

The physical version is already used today in official local tournaments and events.
The August 2026 Kickstarter (physical products — not part of the Steam version) will introduce:

  • retail-ready physical starter sets

  • exclusive launch promos

  • a serialized premium box with foil card set

🗺️ Roadmap (Subject to Change) — Play free in 2026

December 2025 / January 2026

Steam Introversion Launch

March 2026

Full Alpha Version (complete core gameplay)

April 2026

Global Online Ranking launches
Top 50 Play-2-Claim Rewards begin
(physical promo cards sent via mail)

May 2026

Monthly Battlefield Rotations begin

23rd August 2026

Kickstarter: Physical Starter Sets, Promos & Premium Box
Pre-Enlist for a physical reward:

⭐ Play Free in 2026

Star Squadrons is 100% free on Steam throughout 2026 to build a strong, competitive community.
No card purchases, no booster packs yet, no pay-to-win — just pure strategy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X or Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600X or Equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
